author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The Orange Pi Zero 3W is a new single-board computer in a 65 × 32 mm form factor built around the Allwinner A733 processor. title: Orange Pi Zero 3W arrives with A733 SoC in 65 × 32 mm design
